title: Austin Highway Interchange Approval
summary:
*   City leaders convened a special meeting to discuss and authorize a major infrastructure project.
*   The primary decision involved approving an agreement with the State Highway Department.
*   This agreement focused on establishing a crucial highway interchange, linking Bergstrom Field to the area north of the river.
*   The authorization for this vital transportation link received unanimous support from all present council members.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
November 13, 1962
10:00 Α.Μ.
Council Chamber, City Hall
1240
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Palmer presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Absent: None Present also: W. T.
Williams, Jr., City Manager; Doren R. Eskew, City Attorney The Mayor announced this
meeting was called for the purpose of discussing and authorizing an agreement with the
State Highway Department for the interchange from Bergstrom Field to north of the river.
After discussion, Councilman White moved that the City Manager be authorized to enter into
an agreement with the State Highway Department for this interchange from Bergstrom Field
to north of the river. The motion, seconded by Councilman Armstrong, carried by the
following vote: Ayes: Councilmen Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Noes: None
There being no further business the Council adjourned subject to the call of the Mayor.
